dedupe_keys.name: daten der straßenbefahrungen stadt bremen 2019 und 2021

description: Daten der Straßenbefahrungen Stadt Bremen 2019 und 2021 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In 2019 and 2021, the following data from the image data of the rides were evaluated: Drains, stops, canal covers, light room, light signal systems, use and material of road surfaces, traffic signs, access roads. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Road traffic data City of Bremen 2019 and 2021" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bundesstraße, Baulast. The listing shows 2023-10-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
